leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement the font-display property in a CSS @font-face rule
Configure different font-display values (auto, block, swap, fallback, optional) for web fonts
Apply appropriate font-display strategies based on performance and user experience requirements
Manipulate font loading behavior to control text rendering during font downloads
Integrate font-display with existing font declarations to optimize page load
Construct CSS rules that balance font availability with content visibility
Update existing font implementations to include font-display for improved performance
